title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: usage-based billing models in the model selector
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, licence requirements, billing controls and documented navigation agree with the supplied notice and Microsoft Learn. It correctly distinguishes planned in-product credit requests from the existing administrative request experience and identifies the remaining documentation gaps.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users will be able to select UBB models from the Chat model selector.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans for users who consume their credits to request more from tenant administrators.

claims.claim: MC1519122 names GPT-6 Astra as a generally available UBB model with this rollout.
claims.quote: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 will be generally available as UBB models with this rollout.

claims.claim: MC1519122 names Claude Fable 5.1 as a generally available UBB model with this rollout.
claims.quote: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 will be generally available as UBB models with this rollout.

claims.claim: The notice says previously communicated eligibility requirements for these models apply.
claims.quote: Previously communicated eligibility requirements for these models apply.

claims.claim: The notice also covers Copilot in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
claims.quote: These models will be available from Chat in the Microsoft Copilot app and when using Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Users will be able to set reasoning effort when using a UBB model in Chat.

claims.quote: After the initial rollout, we plan to roll out the ability for users to request additional credits from their tenant admin.

claims.claim: MC1519122 gives no date for the later credit-request rollout.
claims.quote: We plan to rollout the ability for users to request credits from their tenant admins after this initial rollout.

claims.claim: Frontier (Public) rollout begins early November 2026.
claims.quote: Frontier (Public): Beginning early November 2026 and expected to complete by mid-November 2026

claims.quote: Frontier (Public): Beginning early November 2026 and expected to complete by mid-November 2026

claims.claim: The feature requires administrator enablement, consistent with admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: To provide users with access to UBB models: ... Enable UBB for users who should have access to the models.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A Microsoft 365 Copilot USL is required in addition to UBB enablement and credits.
claims.quote: Verify that users have a Microsoft 365 Copilot user subscription license (USL). ... Enable UBB for users who should have access to the models. ... Allocate credits to users who should have access to the models.

claims.claim: Consumption is the licensing model for this metered addition.
claims.quote: UBB experiences consume Copilot Credits and require a USL for access.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Variable cost correctly describes usage measured in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Usage-based billing means charges are based on the work performed rather than a flat per-user fee.

claims.claim: The USL is the fixed-price foundation for everyday AI, while UBB covers advanced AI and frontier models.
claims.quote: The USL covers everyday AI work, providing a fixed-price AI foundation for your workforce. ... UBB is used for advanced AI and frontier models, extending beyond the everyday AI included in the USL.

claims.claim: The subscription already includes some model choices alongside the additional UBB models.
claims.quote: Model selection is also part of the USL, with some models included with fair use, such as GPT 5.6 and Sonnet, and others included with limits, such as Opus.

claims.where: summary; Cost and licensing; Why it matters; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Interacting with UBB models consumes Copilot Credits on top of the subscription.
claims.quote: UBB is used in Copilot ... when working with newer agentic frontier models such as Astra and Fable. UBB experiences consume Copilot Credits and require a USL for access.

claims.claim: Administrators must configure a billing policy before users can use experiences requiring UBB.
claims.quote: Admins must set up a billing policy before a user can use AI experiences that require usage-based billing.

claims.where: summary; front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Spending limits are configurable rather than invariably required.
claims.quote: Don't limit monthly spending - Allows the policy to use credits against the organization's billing method without restrictions. ... Select the monthly spending limit for users (optional)

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Credits can be funded through pay-as-you-go, Copilot Credit P3 or existing prepaid capacity packs.
claims.quote: Organizations can access credits through capacity packs, Copilot Credit pre-purchase plans, or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go charges the linked Azure subscription.
claims.quote: If you choose to override by using the pay-as-you-go option, the connected Azure subscription is billed on a pay-as-you-go basis.

claims.claim: Copilot Credit P3 provides discounted commit units over a one-year term.
claims.quote: Copilot Credit pre-purchase plans provide discounted commit units for eligible Copilot Credit usage during a one-year term.

claims.claim: Usage beyond P3 credits can be billed as pay-as-you-go when that is enabled.
claims.quote: Usage beyond available pre-purchased credits can be billed as pay-as-you-go if pay-as-you-go is enabled.

claims.claim: Existing prepaid capacity packs can support services managed by this billing experience.
claims.quote: If you purchased capacity packs, you can use them with the services in this experience.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Learn does not publish per-model Copilot Credit rates for GPT-6 Astra or Claude Fable 5.1 in this Chat rollout.
claims.quote: Searched: GPT-6 Astra credits rate; Claude Fable 5.1 credits rate; Copilot Chat Astra Fable usage based billing models credit consumption pricing. Opened USL/UBB, billing setup and dashboard comparison pages; no Chat model rates found.

claims.claim: Billing and spending-policy configuration is under Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Copilot > Cost Management. ... Select the Configuration tab and then select + Add spending policy.

claims.claim: GET /beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies is the documented Microsoft Graph list operation.
claims.quote: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies?$filter=status eq microsoft.graph.spendingPolicyStatus'enabled'&$orderby=createdDateTime desc&$top=2&$count=true

claims.claim: The listed GET call lists policies rather than configuring limits or alerts.
claims.quote: Get a list of spendingPolicy objects. ... Don't supply a request body for this method.

claims.claim: These beta APIs are subject to change and unsupported in production.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Identity-based spending policies govern usage by users or groups.
claims.quote: Create and name the policy and then choose Identity as the scope. Use this option when you need to manage usage by users or groups for a supported service.

claims.claim: Spending policies govern access and credit spending for UBB AI experiences.
claims.quote: Use spending policies in the Cost Management dashboard to control access and Copilot Credit spending for AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing.

claims.claim: Spending policies define limits but do not reserve or allocate credits to users or groups.
claims.quote: Spending policies are limit-based controls and don't reserve or allocate Copilot Credits to users or groups.

claims.claim: A user moving between Entra ID groups acquires the new group's spending policy.
claims.quote: If a user moves from one Microsoft Entra ID group to another during a billing period, the new group's spending policy becomes effective for the user.

claims.claim: Previously consumed credits remain accounted for when the user's group policy changes.
claims.quote: Credits consumed under the previous spending policy remain part of the user's consumption history and are accounted for when enforcing the spending limit under the new policy.

claims.claim: Administrators can configure monthly policy-level and per-user credit limits.
claims.quote: Select the monthly spending limit for this policy. ... Select monthly budget limits for users (optional). ... Specify the maximum credit limit users can spend per month.

claims.claim: Spending alerts notify recipients at configured thresholds.
claims.quote: Specify the usage threshold for the policy. ... Select the administrators or stakeholders who must receive email notifications when policy usage reaches the threshold.

claims.claim: Users reaching a spending limit lose access to governed agents and services for the rest of the month.
claims.quote: When users hit the limit, they lose access to agents and services for the rest of the month until credits reset on the first of the month.

claims.claim: The monitoring documentation allows a running task to finish after exceeding a group policy's per-user limit.
claims.quote: Users in a group spending policy that exceed their per-user spending limit: If a running task exceeds the per-user limit, it can complete without interruption.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Cost Management dashboard reports in credits rather than currency.
claims.quote: Everything in this view is expressed in Copilot Credits, not currency.

claims.claim: Dashboard totals can be point-in-time views rather than finalized invoice totals.
claims.quote: It's not the same as an invoice view. Dashboard totals and exports might be point-in-time views and can refresh at different intervals.

claims.claim: The request-access control is under Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > All Settings > Access to usage-based billing experiences.
claims.quote: Go to Copilot > Settings > All Settings. ... Select Access to usage-based billing experiences.

claims.claim: No automation equivalent is documented for the setting controlling who can request access to UBB experiences.
claims.quote: Searched: Access to usage-based billing experiences Graph; Microsoft Graph Copilot access request spending policy settings usage based billing discovery API. Opened request-access and discovery-setting pages; results documented UI and spending-policy APIs, not this setting.

claims.claim: The request-access setting requires the Global administrator role.
claims.quote: To configure the setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center, you need to be assigned to the Global administrator role.

claims.claim: Changes to the request-access setting can take up to 24 hours to apply.
claims.quote: Changes to this setting might take up to 24 hours to apply.

claims.claim: This setting governs who can request a spending policy and does not itself finish UBB setup.
claims.quote: Choose who can request a spending policy. Your selection controls who can request access. It does not complete the usage-based billing setup by itself.

claims.claim: Selecting No users in the request-access control blocks requests, not model visibility or existing access.
claims.quote: This setting controls what happens ... when a user ... does not have a spending policy assigned to them. ... No users: Users cannot request a spending policy. Instead, they'll be presented with a link to learn more

claims.claim: The Anthropic path follows Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic > Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences.
claims.quote: select Copilot > Settings > View all. ... Select AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors. ... under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic ... Under Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences

claims.claim: No automation equivalent is documented for this Anthropic provider-access setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic subprocessors PowerShell Graph; Microsoft Graph beta Copilot admin settings AI provider Anthropic access subprocessor configuration API. Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor and copilot-anthropic-apps; results describe admin UI, not an equivalent API.

claims.claim: AI Administrator or Global Administrator can configure Anthropic model access.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the AI Administrator or Global Administrator role to perform this task.

claims.claim: The Anthropic control governs access to that provider's models, not GPT-6 Astra.
claims.quote: These assignments are applied at the provider level and enforced across Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio experiences. When access is limited by user or group membership, only the assigned users can use Copilot features or agents that rely on that AI provider.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models in Microsoft Copilot are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.claim: Claude models are also currently excluded from applicable in-country processing commitments.
claims.quote: currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary, and when applicable, in-country processing commitments.

claims.claim: Microsoft Product Terms and the DPA apply where Anthropic acts as a Microsoft subprocessor, excluding models labelled with Data Retention.
claims.quote: Unless models are labeled "Anthropic models with Data Retention," the Microsoft Product Terms and Microsoft Data Protection Addendum (DPA) apply to the use of Claude models from Anthropic through Microsoft's enterprise Online Services.

claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention are off by default.
claims.quote: Anthropic models with Data Retention (such as Fable 5.0) have additional controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center and are off by default for all scenarios

claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention require a separate explicit tenant administrator opt-in.
claims.quote: No users will have access to these models until the tenant admin explicitly opts in to enable use of Anthropic models with Data Retention.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Models labelled with Data Retention use Anthropic's own terms rather than Microsoft's Product Terms and DPA.
claims.quote: Anthropic acts as an independent processor and use of Anthropic models with Data Retention is subject to acceptance of Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service and Anthropic's Data Protection Addendum

claims.claim: Different Fable-class models can have different terms, including eligibility-dependent subprocessor treatment for Fable 5.1.
claims.quote: for certain organizations, Fable 5.1 is available with Anthropic acting as a subprocessor and Microsoft's Product Terms and Data Protection Addendum (DPA) apply. ... Other Fable-class models may be provided as "Anthropic models with Data Retention"

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls: Credit requests path
claims.claim: The administrative Credit requests page opens through Copilot > Cost Management > Overview > Top Actions > View requests.
claims.quote: go to Copilot > Cost Management. ... Select the Overview tab. ... From the Top Actions section, you can View requests ... To view and approve credit requests from end users, select View requests. The Credit requests page displays all pending and approved requests.

claims.claim: The existing Credit requests page allows administrators to view and approve user credit requests.
claims.quote: To view and approve credit requests from end users, select View requests. The Credit requests page displays all pending and approved requests.

claims.claim: Requests unmatched by a custom request policy continue through Microsoft's credit request service and can be resolved in the admin center.
claims.quote: Requests that don't match a custom request policy continue through the Microsoft credit request service and can be resolved in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly established that future model-selector requests will reach the documented Credit requests page.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat UBB model selector credit requests; Microsoft Graph Copilot access request spending policy settings. Read MC1519122 and Monitor Copilot Credit spending: generic requests are documented, but no explicit linkage to future selector requests.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Open questions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The selector's presentation of UBB models to users without enablement and credits is not established.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat UBB model selector hide disabled; Copilot GPT-6 Astra Claude Fable 5.1 model selector credit rate government availability hide models. Read MC1519122, access-request and discovery-setting pages; no selector-specific presentation documented.

claims.claim: Government cloud rollout dates for this specific UBB model-selector change are not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat UBB model selector government GCC. Read roadmap, MC1519122 and Learn excerpts on GCC Anthropic availability; these give no government rollout date for this UBB selector change.

claims.claim: Global administrator and Billing administrator can add, select and change billing methods.
claims.quote: Global administrator and Billing administrator roles can add, select, and change billing methods, and set billing methods in policies.

claims.claim: The setup page says AI administrator and License administrator can edit policies and manage limits and alerts.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies, manage limits and alerts, and billing methods.

claims.claim: The setup page says AI administrator and License administrator cannot create spending policies.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies, manage limits and alerts, and billing methods. However, they can't create spending policies.

claims.claim: The same setup page inconsistently includes License Administrator among read-only roles.
claims.quote: AI Reader, Global Reader, License Administrator, and other supported reader-based roles can view consumption dashboards and reports. These roles provide read-only access to consumption information

claims.claim: Supported reader roles can view consumption.
claims.quote: AI Reader, Global Reader, License Administrator, and other supported reader-based roles can view consumption dashboards and reports.

claims.claim: A spending policy can automatically apply to newly supported services when Auto-apply new services is enabled.
claims.quote: When a spending policy has Auto-apply new services turned on, newly supported Microsoft Copilot services and agents are automatically added to the policy as they become available.

claims.claim: Azure Cost Management shows linked-subscription pay-as-you-go charges and P3 purchase or amortized costs.
claims.quote: Azure Cost Management shows pay-as-you-go charges and purchase or amortized cost information for Copilot Credit pre-purchase plans (P3) and Microsoft Agent pre-purchase plans (P3).

claims.claim: Azure does not show prepaid capacity pack consumption; the Microsoft 365 or Power Platform admin center does.
claims.quote: Azure Cost Management doesn't show consumption against Prepaid Capacity packs. Use the Microsoft 365 admin center or Power Platform admin center, as applicable, to monitor Prepaid Capacity Pack credit usage.

claims.claim: The deprecated AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing setting controlled visibility, while Cost Management controls access and spending.
claims.quote: The AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing setting is deprecated. ... this setting controls visibility, while Cost Management under the Copilot node in the Microsoft 365 admin center controls access and spending.
